file path /var/tmp/ references suggest Linux environment

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software – converts point-score (点数) module data into medical treatment act (診療行為) records, handling disease name (病名) registration, insurance combination, hospitalization counts, and related clinical data
purpose.summary: ORCL0031 is a subprogram within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that converts point-score/treatment-act master data into work treatment-act records. It manages patient disease-name (byomei) registration and updates, insurance information, hospitalization flags, and various medical billing calculations. The program has an extensive revision history spanning 2000–2012 covering group treatment, UID tables, public-expense support, and quantity decimal handling.

notable_features: 42 COPY statements with REPLACING for modular copybook inclusion
31 CALL statements indicating heavy subprogram delegation
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Extensive flag area (FLG-AREA) with many single-digit PIC 9(01) flags
OCCURS clauses for disease-name and insurance tables
Long revision history (2000–2012) with named maintainers
verdict.notes: Source is truncated to first 16000 chars; full file is ~205KB / 4709 lines. Japanese comments are EUC-JP encoded but decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in the displayed text. Dialect identified as GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL based on Linux path references and JMA ORCA project context; no IBM-specific extensions observed.
